post.description: Single submission per order. Send `storeRate` and/or `deliveryRate` (1–5) — at least one is required — in one request. The first successful submission sets `order.rated = true` and blocks any further rating. Use the order response `ratingEligibility` flags to build the rating screen. See docs/order-rating-mobile-guide.md.
